i18n.enSummary: Are you running out of manpower and struggling to respond to inquiries and input? In this article, we will explain 8 examples of the use of AI agents that can easily produce results for small and medium-sized enterprises, as well as cost patterns and subsidies that can start from thousands of yen per month, based on public data and real-name examples.
